description: Two session-lifecycle hooks. SessionStart injects open questions from the schmug/agent-notes board (pairs with the ask-board skill). Stop checks whether the session left anything unresolved and, if so, blocks once so it gets filed (pairs with the file-concerns skill).

hooks.command: q=$(gh discussion list -R schmug/agent-notes --state open --limit 20 --json number,title,answered,category --jq '.discussions[]|select(.answered==false)|"#\(.number) \(.title)\(if .category.name!="Q&A" then "  [!! MISFILED in \(.category.name) - cannot be answered, move to Q&A]" else "" end)"' 2>/dev/null); rc=$?; jq -nc --arg q "$q" --arg rc "$rc" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:((if $rc!="0" then "Question board (schmug/agent-notes): unreachable this session." elif $q=="" then "Question board (schmug/agent-notes): no open questions." else "Open agent questions (answer only if your work happens to cover it; do not chase):\n"+$q end)+"\nHit a durable unknown this session? If no grep or command can settle it, and it is not a call only the user can make, but a later session in different context could - post it with the shipofclaudius:ask-board skill, state the assumption you are proceeding under, and keep going. The board never gates work.")}}'; true

hooks.prompt:
Either this session surfaced nothing unresolved, or every unresolved item has already been recorded this session — by invoking the shipofclaudius:file-concerns skill, or by appending to ~/.claude/concerns-spool.jsonl after a failed gh call. The condition is also met outright whenever the hook input below reports stop_hook_active true: it was already evaluated once this turn, the session has since responded to it, and re-evaluating the same transcript cannot produce anything the first pass did not. Unresolved means: a completion claim resting on a check that was never actually run, a scope reduction never stated plainly to the user, or a doubt about whether the change is correct. Only work this session itself performed counts; transcript text the session quoted, reviewed, or diagnosed from elsewhere is evidence about that other session and is not unresolved work here. Work that is still legitimately in flight — a background task, a spawned agent, or an armed monitor that the transcript shows is still running and whose result the session is waiting on — is not unresolved; a check that has been started and has not yet returned is a pending check, not a skipped one. A question or decision the session has put to the user and is waiting on is handed off, not unresolved: the session cannot answer it, and blocking only keeps the answer from arriving. Where such a hand-off is the only item outstanding, the condition is unachievable in this session rather than merely unmet, and the impossible flag applies. Default to satisfied — if nothing clearly unresolved stands out, the condition is met.

Hook input: $ARGUMENTS
